jobs.description:
PVH is one of the most successful fashion and lifestyle companies in the world. Our brand portfolio includes the iconic brands CALVIN KLEIN and TOMMY HILFIGER, with more than 30.000 employees operating in over 40 countries. PVH stands for development and innovation like no other company with the ongoing digitalization and integration of all channels.

One of PVH's greatest strengths is our people and our shared desire to create an inclusive work environment where every individual is valued, and every voice is heard. Together, we are committed to a more diverse and fair fashion industry to drive sustainable change both at PVH and in our industry.

The head office for the DACH and EEC markets, covering 13 countries with more than 2.700 employees, is in Düsseldorf and is the main location of around 500 employees.

Our Office HR Business Partnering team drives global people strategies aligned with business priorities. We partner with senior leadership on organizational change, talent management, and performance optimization, using data-driven insights to shape a high-performing culture.

As a Sales Manager at PVH you will face a frequently challenging environment as a brand ambassador and performance driven expert. You are the voice for your market and to our headquarters in Amsterdam. Team leader and -developer, that can energize their sales teams and a strategic visionary of all Division related tasks and challenges from a sales perspective.

A day in the life of a Teamlead Strategic Sales Manager E-Commerce (m/f/x):

- You will lead, develop and motivate your cross- divisional sales team with passion and integrity – thereby empower individuality and inclusivity
- You will be fully in charge as number one go-to person for a specific European PurePlayer within our PVH Region West and European online environment to drive and streamline all related topics from end-to-end
- You are overseeing and owning the strategic direction of one of our largest European Pure Player’s to create a holistic brand strategy
- You will plan, control, and handle the operational and strategic cooperation (including action and annual planning, control of marketing activities, annual marketing planning)
- You will be responsible for sales and revenue planning, the achievement of specified targets and to maximize potentials
- You will develop and advance a segmented product strategy as well as a future-oriented product build-up with a view to all digital channels by reading and analyzing all relevant customer data
- You will build strong partnerships with internal and external stakeholders to drive a cross-functional approach, e.g., relevant partners and customers, our headquarter in Amsterdam, Customer Service, Marketing and our external Marketing agency
- You will drive cross- functional projects in an agile E-Commerce team structure

What do we need from you? You have:  

- Minimum of 5 years profound work experience as Sales- and/or Key Account Manager in E-Commerce or Omni-Channel (textile or related fields)
- Commit to the E3/2 hybrid work model: 3 office days and 2 remote working days per week
- Proven experience in leading a small but agile (sales) team
- High degree of team spirit
- Solution-oriented and precise working method and a strong analytical skillset
- Strong sales and negotiation skills and natural desire for improving solutions across people, processes and systems by applying a strategic mindset
- A hands-on mentality in working with frequently changing tools and software to further translate work resources into efficiency
- The ability to communicate on all levels to influence and drive interdepartmental collaboration
- Very good command of written and spoken German and English
- Very good command of MS-Office skills (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

What you can expect from us:

- PVH offers you a smart working model (hybrid) including a flex office solution, a "work from anywhere" concept, meeting-free Fridays and many other components
- Lead Yourself. Lead Together. Lead the Way. The PVH Leadership Behaviors are the actions that unlock the potential of each of us. Whether you lead a team, a project or contribute your own expertise, everyone is a leader at PVH
- We promote a culture of development and offer training and learning opportunities through our own PVH University
- Multiple employee benefits such as employee discounts, mobility offers, internal sports classes and other initiatives

Our employees come together from all areas of life and all corners of the world. Inclusion and diversity are a key pillar of our corporate culture. We know that diversity makes us stronger. Regardless of your origin, nationality, faith, disability, age, marital status, partnership status, sexual orientation, or gender you are welcome here.

PVH is one of the most successful fashion and lifestyle companies in the world. Our brand portfolio includes the iconic brands CALVIN KLEIN and TOMMY HILFIGER, with more than 30,000 employees operating in over 40 countries. Together, we are committed to a more diverse and fair fashion industry to drive sustainable change both at PVH and across our industry.

The head office for the DACH and EEC markets, covering 13 countries with more than 2,700 employees, is located in Düsseldorf and is the main workplace for around 500 employees.

As an Energy & Sustainability Specialist, you will be responsible for the administration, maintenance, and sustainability performance of all Calvin Klein and Tommy Hilfiger O&O stores within Hub West (EMEA).

You will manage administrative and commercial processes related to technical maintenance, servicing, and facility operations. This includes coordinating maintenance activities, handling damages and insurance claims, and working closely with internal stakeholders, landlords, and external service providers. A key focus of the role is driving energy efficiency, sustainability initiatives, and compliance with environmental and technical standards.

A day in the life of an Energy & Sustainability Specialist:

- Collect, monitor, and analyze energy consumption data across stores and office locations
- Develop and maintain the Energy Management System (EMS) in line with DIN / ISO standards (e.g. ISO 50001)
- Ensure compliance with German and EU energy regulations and support certification processes
- Track and evaluate energy-saving initiatives and sustainability measures
- Drive annual energy optimization and sustainability projects
- Lead and coordinate cross-functional Energy Task Force activities
- Prepare reports, KPIs, and presentations for General Management
- Support audits related to energy, sustainability, and utilities
- Implement sustainability and energy efficiency programs across retail and office locations
- Ensure compliance with environmental, health & safety, and fire protection regulations (e.g. BAFA, BGHW, TÜV)
- Coordinate maintenance, servicing, and facility operations across multiple locations
- Manage repair works, technical inspections, and preventive maintenance
- Monitor technical systems and identify improvement opportunities

What do we need from you? You have:

- A degree or vocational training in Facility Management, Engineering, Sustainability, Energy Management, or a related field
- 2–4 years of experience in facility management, technical services, sustainability, or energy management
- Experience in retail, real estate, or multi-site environments is a plus
- Strong organizational and coordination skills with a structured way of working
- A proactive, solution-oriented mindset and ability to manage multiple priorities
- Strong communication skills and confidence working with various stakeholders
- Experience with energy management systems and audits
- Knowledge of EU/German energy and environmental regulations (e.g. ISO 50001)
- Familiarity with health & safety standards and compliance requirements
- Business fluent German and English (written and spoken)
- Willingness to travel and a valid driving license

What you can expect from us:

- A smart working model (hybrid), including flex office solutions, work-from-anywhere concept, and meeting-free Fridays
- Lead Yourself. Lead Together. Lead the Way. – our PVH Leadership Behaviors empower everyone to take ownership
- A strong culture of development with extensive training opportunities via PVH University
- A wide range of employee benefits, including employee discounts, mobility offers, and wellbeing initiatives

Our employees come from all walks of life and all corners of the world. Inclusion and diversity are a key pillar of our corporate culture. We know that diversity makes us stronger. Regardless of your origin, nationality, faith, disability, age, marital status, sexual orientation, or gender – you are welcome here.

The Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy (MPI-SP) in Bochum is a research institute of the Max Planck Society for the Advancement of Science. It conducts interdisciplinary research on the diverse aspects of IT security and data protection. The newly established and expanding institute will ultimately comprise 18 research groups and employ around 200 staff members and guests. The institute cooperates with the Faculty of Computer Science at Ruhr University Bochum. Bochum is one of the world’s leading research locations for cybersecurity and is home to Europe’s largest training center in this field as well as a vibrant start-up scene.

Starting immediately, we are seeking a

Project Coordinator - AI Competition (d/f/m), 50%

to support the organization, communication, and implementation of an AI competition. The competition combines cutting-edge research in artificial intelligence and cybersecurity with the goal of advancing AI-based cybersecurity technologies. Teams from academia, start-ups, and industry will develop autonomous AI-based systems for identifying software vulnerabilities and assessing their exploitability.

The position is part-time (50%) and project-funded until the end of December 2028.

Website and Communication Materials: Coordinate and prepare content for the project website, newsletters, flyers, posters, social media, and other communication channels.
Public Relations: Coordinate media and public-relations activities around major project milestones and events in collaboration with MPI-SP’s communication structures and the project partners. Support communication and coordination with industry partners, policymakers, and other relevant stakeholders.
Project Coordination: Support meetings, schedules, documentation, reporting, and other organizational aspects of the project and ensure effective communication between the scientific team, project partners, participants, and external stakeholders.

A Master’s degree or comparable qualification, preferably in communication, event management, project management, science management, or a related field.
Experience in project coordination, event organization, communication, or public relations.
Excellent organizational and project-management skills and the ability to coordinate multiple activities and stakeholders simultaneously.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in German and English.
The ability to communicate professionally with researchers, companies, public-sector organizations, and other external stakeholders.
A proactive, reliable, and solution-oriented working style.
Confidence in using standard digital communication and collaboration tools.

Experience in science communication, research organizations, technology competitions, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, or publicly funded research projects is advantageous but not required.

Doctoral Position: Gene Expression Regulation (f/m/x)

Uhlirova Lab | Institute for Genetics | CECAD

We are one of the largest and oldest universities in Europe and one of the most important employers in our region. Our broad range of subjects, the dynamic development of our main research areas and our central location in Cologne make us attractive for students and researchers from around the world. We offer a wide range of career opportunities in science, technology, and administration.

The Uhlirova lab (www.uni-koeln.de/inter-fak/cecad/uhlirova/) explores how stress-inducible signaling pathways control gene expression and influence tissue homeostasis and longevity. To tackle these questions, we combine the power of functional genetics in Drosophila and mouse models with cutting-edge molecular and cell biology, multi-omics approaches, advanced microscopy, and bioinformatics. We are looking for a highly motivated and curious doctoral candidate (f/m/x) to join our dynamic team. You will have the opportunity to lead your own project, contribute to collaborative research, and develop skills at the interface of genetics, molecular and cell biology, and systems-level analysis.

The University of Cologne promotes equal opportunities and diversity. Women will be considered preferentially in accordance with the Equal Opportunities Act of North Rhine-Westphalia (Landesgleichstellungsgesetz - LGG NRW). We also expressly welcome applications from all suitable candidates regardless of their gender, nationality, ethnic and social origin, religion, disability, age, personal orientation and identity.

The position is available from immediately on a part-time basis (25,89 hours per week).The position is to be filled for three years. If the applicant meets the relevant wage requirements and personal qualifications, the salary is based on remuneration group 13 TV-L of the pay scale for the German public sector.

Please apply online without a photo with proof of the required
qualifications and the following documents:

A cover letter describing your motivation to join our research group and information on your career achievements (1 page max.)
Academic Curriculum Vitae, including your publication list and contact information for three references
Copies of your degree and qualification certificate

The reference number is Wiss2608-13. The application deadline is 27 September 2026.
For further inquiries, please contact Dr Esther Wollert (uhlirova-jobs@uni-koeln.de) and take a look at our FAQs. YOUR TASKS

To study the crosstalk between transcription and pre-mRNA splicing under physiological, stress, and disease conditions
To investigate mechanisms underlying spliceosome assembly and functional plasticity
To uncover what renders different transcripts, cells, and tissues sensitive to aberrant splicing

Within Yara, Crop Nutrition and Biologicals Products R&D leads the development and innovation of our crop nutrition solutions. We generate scientific and agronomic insights through laboratory, greenhouse, and field trials; translate these into product concepts and development projects, and support the wider organization with robust, evidence-based knowledge.

We are seeking a curious, proactive, and impact-driven scientist to advance our product development and innovation pipeline for new fertilizers and sustainable technologies that complement and strengthen Yara’s premium crop nutrition portfolio. Scientist - Crop Nutrition Products (f/m/d)

Design and coordinate R&D projects focused on developing high-efficiency phosphorous (P) and nitrogen (N) fertilizer product candidates.

jobs.description:
As the leading company in the field of software solutions for healthcare, we operate in 19 countries and employ over 9,000 dedicated staff members. You will work in a dynamic and innovative environment full of opportunities. With your commitment and passion, you have the chance to make a sustainable difference.

CGM Leverages AI: We’re looking for people who feel the power of AI in the e-health environment, who want to help shape change, and who are driven by a curious passion to see how technology can make healthcare smarter, simpler, and better.

Together, we are shaping the healthcare system of the future. Become part of our mission and make a difference - for a world where knowledge saves lives!

Are you passionate about groundbreaking products? Do you have the talent to turn ideas into real, valuable solutions-while always keeping the bigger picture in mind? Then we’d love to meet you!

You take end-to-end accountability for a large, distributed engineering organization that owns our ambulatory SaaS solutions and the shared framework modules used across all AIS DE products.

You co-define and drive the strategic product-technology roadmap for our cloud-based ambulatory portfolio in close collaboration with the executive leadership team.

You ensure that healthcare regulatory requirements-including medical device regulations, audits, and compliance-are rigorously embedded into product development, delivery, and operations.

You lead senior leaders and cross-functional teams, continuously increasing scalability, quality, AI maturity, and innovation velocity across products and platforms.

You represent the domain internally and externally, build strong executive-level stakeholder relationships, and position CGM as a leading SaaS provider in the Health-IT market.

Long-standing leadership experience at Director / VP / CTO level in SaaS product development, ideally with responsibility for large, distributed engineering organizations and complex product portfolios.

Exceptional academic background with a completed university degree and excellent grades, preferably in computer science, medical informatics, engineering, or a comparable technical field.

Deep expertise in cloud architectures and SaaS platforms, including modern DevOps practices and reliability engineering; hands-on experience with healthcare regulations (medical devices, audits, certifications) is a strong advantage.

Proven track record of driving AI adoption in engineering organizations, ideally with first-hand familiarity of Claude Code or comparable agentic coding tools (agents, skills, and workflows) and experience shaping AI pipelines, harnesses, and context engineering at organizational scale.

Excellent English and very good German, a strategic and entrepreneurial mindset, strong execution focus, outstanding leadership and communication skills, and the ability to guide complex organizations through transformation while staying clearly aligned with our healthcare purpose.

Mobile work: Work flexibly on the move two days a week and on site three days a week.

Attractive locations: In addition to fully equipped workplaces, regular events such as summer parties and Christmas parties await you at our locations.

Development: Our in-house academy and our portfolio of external cooperation partners will support you in your further development.

Health: Health is a valuable asset for us. Our in-house canteen offers a selection of tasty and healthy dishes every day, and we welcome you to our fully equipped fitness center for weekly courses (online & offline).

More is always possible: The kindergarten on our CGM campus in Koblenz helps our employees to organize their working day even more flexibly. We also offer corporate benefits, the option of a job bike, a company pension scheme, and much more.

Diversity is part of CGM! We look forward to receiving your application regardles...

PhD Candidate (f/m/x) in Ophthalmic Epidemiology
Code: 1547/2026/5

full-time, 3 years, extension possible
Site: Bonn

The German Center for Neurodegenerative Diseases (DZNE) is a globally leading, internationally oriented research institution dedicated to discovering new approaches for the prevention and treatment of neurodegenerative diseases. Conduct research in ophthalmic epidemiology of aging in humans, with a focus on age-related macular degeneration. In particular, we expect you to:

Perform integrative analyses combining multi-omics data with eye imaging data
Contribute to ophthalmic data collection and processing
Contribute to omics data processing, statistical analyses, and the preparation of manuscripts for publication in peer-reviewed journals
Present research findings at national and international conferences
Actively participate in project-related meetings, documentation, and reporting of project progress
Contribute to ongoing projects within the group and develop independent research ideas

A Master’s degree (or equivalent) in a relevant field, such as epidemiology, bioinformatics, medicine, biomedical sciences, or a related discipline
A genuine interest in scientific research and quantitative analysis
Strong proficiency in written and spoken English
Statistical knowledge and experience with programming in R
Experience with epidemiological research or large-scale observational studies, particularly involving omics and eye imaging data, including the application of machine learning methods for pattern recognition and predictive modeling is desirable but not a prerequisite
Strong analytical skills, independent and critical thinking, and attention to detail
Flexibility, strong interpersonal skills, and enjoyment of working in an interdisciplinary and international team
Proficiency in written and spoken German

Your role in Cutting-Edge Research

The PhD project will be supervised by Dr. Dr. Petra Larsen, scientific lead of the ophthalmic epidemiology team. The research is embedded in the large population-based Rhineland Study, a comprehensive long-term cohort investigating determinants of brain health. We are seeking an enthusiastic and ambitious early-career researcher (f/m/x) with a strong interest in investigating multi-omic and eye imaging signatures in the context of age-related macular degeneration.

The Ophthalmic Epidemiology research team investigates deep phenotyping of retinal ageing, preclinical changes and disease, as well as the comprehensive assessment of risk factors driving the onset and progression of both preclinical and clinical disease. These include genetic, molecular and environmental factors.

The PhD thesis will focus on the relationship between ageing and age-related macular degeneration and encompass the full breadth of scientific work, including the development and implementation of study protocols, coordination and supervision of data collection, and data analysis and publication.

The project will leverage data from the Rhineland Study, a deeply-phenotyped, large-scale population-based cohort study. Available data include comprehensive multi-omics data, including (epi)genomics, transcriptomics, metabolomics, lipidomics, and proteomics; eye imaging data, advanced MRI data as well as extensive behavioral and clinical data, including cognitive and neurological assessments, cardiovascular assessments, medical history, and medication use. The study currently includes over 14,000 individuals, of whom more than 6,000 already have longitudinal data. Additional baseline and follow-up data collection is ongoing.

Innovation and internationality - a forward-looking infrastructure, modern laboratory and office equipment, software tools and the opportunity for international exchange with your colleagues from 65 nations

WE ARE LOOKING FOR YOU AS

COMPENSATION, BENEFITS & PROCESSES SPECIALIST (M/W/D)

COLOGNE

Interzero is one of the leading service providers in closing product, material, and logistics cycles and a pioneer in plastics recycling, operating Europe’s largest sorting capacity. Guided by the principle of “zero waste solutions,” the company supports more than 80,000 customers across Europe in the responsible handling of recyclable materials, helping them improve their sustainability performance and conserve primary  resources. With around 2,000 employees, Interzero generates annual revenues of nearly one billion euros. According to Fraunhofer UMSICHT, Interzero’s recycling activities alone saved approximately 1.04 million tons of greenhouse gas emissions and 8.09 million tons of primary raw  materials compared to primary production in 2024. Further information at: www.interzero.de.

What is it about?

- Frameworks & Governance: You develop compensation and benefits principles, frameworks, processes and governance standards aligned with business and HR requirements.
- Compensation Processes: You manage recurring compensation and benefits processes, including salary reviews, benchmarking and remuneration analyses.
- Job Architecture: You design job architecture, grading, salary structures and related decision criteria to support internal consistency and market competitiveness.
- Data Analysis: You analyze compensation, benefits, workforce and cost data and translate findings into clear recommendations for HR and business stakeholders.
- Process Optimization: You optimize compensation- and benefits-related processes, controls, templates and digital workflows to improve quality, efficiency and transparency.
- Project Leadership: You lead cross-functional compensation, benefits and process improvement projects, including timelines, risks, deliverables and implementation.
- Stakeholder Advisory: You advise HR and business stakeholders on compensation and benefits matters, ensuring consistent application of frameworks and processes.
- Cross-Functional Coordination: You coordinate with HR Systems, Finance, Legal, Payroll and external partners to ensure compliant processes, reliable data and effective implementation.

- Diverse Range of Tasks: A broad and varied range of tasks awaits you, allowing you to work independently at a leading environmental service provider.
- Contribution to Company Development: You actively contribute to the further development and growth of the company, in line with our vision of a future without waste.
- Flat Hierarchies and Creative Freedom: You will encounter flat hierarchies within the company, enjoy a high degree of freedom to shape and decide and can actively contribute your own ideas.
